sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tm_research_events) AS raw_event_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tm_research_events_session_period) AS classified_event_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tm_research_events WHERE received_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-16 00:22:42+00') AS pilot_rows_unchanged, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'tm_research_events_session_period') AS view_exists;
